scope: Synthetic ordinary managed DOCX text boxes in dedicated body paragraphs, with explicit caller-selected anchor order, top-and-bottom wrapping, supported link and page selection. This is a working-tree observation, not live Word, a screen-reader study or general #154 qualification.
schema: Open XML SDK 3.5.1 reported zero errors for the hand-authored source and saved DOCX; validator DLL SHA-256 4126071233c70310683c0fa0b65648bbd34839afa7b0a2309fba13c22501ddec. Normalized ZIP timestamps made the source and saved outputs byte-identical on a repeated local run.
independentValidation: Pinned veraPDF 1.30.2 image sha256:d5ee329657cf9bc4b2400392dd54c7d0a0ce9980ff6fa2da5590eebeec007cdb, with network disabled, accepted the one-page, two-page, selected-page and two-box PDFs and rejected the untagged control. Test-only pypdf 6.10.0 (BSD-3-Clause) independently verified structure order, all marked-content/ParentTree owner associations and the link annotation/OBJR relationship. It rejected separately corrupted order, parent ownership and link targets, as well as the untagged control.
result: The source order is Before box, Box first, Details, Box last, After box; the selected-page output correctly omits Before box. The two-box case preserves both anchor positions in logical order. Multipage and selected outputs have their own verified page/annotation ParentTree mappings. Saved DOCX retains editable box content; a separate test verifies authored title/description retention, which this PDF/UA subset rejects instead of dropping.
retainedEarlierAttempts: The first alternative-text negative did not reject because the reader discarded text-box docPr descriptions; the reader/cloner/writer now retain bounded descriptions and titles, and non-DOCX output reports their loss. The first full schema check failed eight cases on a fixture with four missing required anchor attributes and a missing simplePos child. A reconstructed negative control SHA-256 c0227bb925b2fbcff434c4e556b67d32d720c26d551a5c875cda3906defa8ce3 yields the same five schema errors; the corrected source and output have zero. The first pypdf checker expected a newline that pypdf omitted at a page boundary; it now derives paragraph boundaries from the structure tree, and the four corruption controls still fail for their intended reasons.
limitations: Generated documents, PDFs and validator XML remain scratch artifacts. The implementation does not qualify notes, text-box alternative descriptions, mixed owners, arbitrary placement/wrapping, linked/rotated/fitted boxes, native typography, tables or story owners. Exact-commit, package and hosted runtime evidence are separate.
